goals.statement: Determine whether a dinosaur could fit inside the referenced school under the hypothetical premise that dinosaurs are alive today, without choosing an implementation path (single-step feasibility intent).
Interpret the target as the user’s specific school ("my school") as the object of the fit assessment.

outcomes.description: Produce an information-style answer that is contingent on school and dinosaur size context, reporting whether fit is possible or indeterminate.

unknowns.question: What is the intended dinosaur species or size class (the phrase "one" is underspecified)?
What are the physical dimensions of the relevant school space (floor area, clear height, door constraints)?
What does "fit inside" mean (entire body within building footprint vs classroom-level fit)?
